text:
molly_marketing: Quick thread to lock down Mariner customer story logistics — interview slot, hero quote, and legal release timeline. Target publish = 48h after webinar.

diego_cs: Mariner can do Wed 11am PT or Fri 3pm PT. Prefer Wed 11.

molly_marketing: Wed 11am PT good for producer. I'll reserve 45 min and request recording + headshot.

diego_cs: Invite sent to emily@marinerhealth.com. Included agenda: 1) demo walkthrough 2) topline wins 3) quote capture.

sam_pm: For product, we need one hero sentence (public), plus two supporting bullets (technical ok for blog). Also please avoid precise p99 numbers in hero without legal sign-off.

kai_prod: If they mention latency, use internal benchmark phrasing: "measured 2.8x improvement in end-to-end inference p99" — I'll paste the slide excerpt after this.

helen_legal: Legal checklist: signed release, citation of benchmark attachments, and approval of final quoted text. Route the release to customer and cc legal@redwood. We need clearance before any public snippet.

molly_marketing: Diego — can you attach the release draft to the calendar invite and ask them to sign before the call? We can also do verbal approval during the call but prefer signed.

diego_cs: Done. I attached the release PDF and added a note: please countersign pre-call if possible.

molly_marketing: Pre-call check — producer will do a 10-min pre-brief at 10:50 PT. Please join.

ops-bot: Reminder: upload recordings to shared drive with tag #mariner-voice and set retention=90d after publish.

kai_prod: Slide excerpt: "Internal tests measured a 2.8x improvement in end-to-end inference p99 latency for Mariner's recommendation pipeline when using Redwood Dedicated."

helen_legal: Suggest minor edits for public copy: replace "Internal tests measured" with "In our tests" and note that logs are available on request. Also avoid referencing competitor comparisons. Proposed: "In our tests, Redwood Dedicated measured a 2.8x improvement in end-to-end inference p99 latency for Mariner's recommendation pipeline."

molly_marketing: Good — I'll draft two hero variants after the call: one concise for the landing hero and one slightly expanded for the blog.

sam_pm: Also flag: if they reference throughput gains, let's get the concrete metric (requests/sec or QPS) so we can publish a supporting chart.

diego_cs: Mariner signed and confirmed Wed 11am PT. Release attached and countersigned.

molly_marketing: Amazing — next actions: 1) Producer pre-brief 10:50 (molly) 2) Interview Wed 11 (molly/diego) 3) Capture hero quote + 2 bullets (sam) 4) Legal to review final text post-transcript (helen) 5) Upload assets + set embargo window 48h (molly).

helen_legal: I'll review the draft quotes after you drop transcript. Please @helen_legal in-thread when uploaded.

molly_marketing: Will drop quote variants in here within 24 hours of the call. If anyone wants to propose alternate hero lines now, post them. Otherwise I'll post 2 options after we transcribe. :thumbsup:

diego_cs: Thanks all — looping back if Mariner wants edits.

molly_marketing: Closing for now. Will reopen after we have transcript + quotes.
